title: TICOM and ALSOS technology retrieval
summary: Jesse Michels tells of TICOM and ALSOS technology retrieval, about 1944-1945 at Europe, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Nazis had all this advanced technology and you had TACOM and ASOS.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that at the end of World War Two, in 1944 and 1945, the Nazis had a great deal of advanced technology in Europe. He names two efforts, TICOM and ALSOS, Allied teams that went in to gather that German technology and know-how. He raises it because, if true, it would show a model for how captured exotic technology could be quietly collected by governments.
